options.name: Logic Difficulty
options.doc: Movement the logic expects (Open World rules). Developer Intended: what the developers expect a first-time player to know in each room. Vanilla Movement: any movement or trick taught anywhere in the base game. Assist Mode: invincibility, infinite dashes and infinite stamina.
fr: Ce que la logique suppose que tu sais faire. Intention des développeurs : ce que le jeu apprend au premier passage. Mouvements du jeu de base : toute technique enseignée quelque part dans le jeu. Mode assistance : invincibilité, dashs et endurance infinis.

options.name: Room Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffle the rooms inside each chapter (never across chapters). The start and end rooms stay those of the game. Off: every chapter keeps its vanilla layout.
fr: Les salles de chaque chapitre sont placées dans un ordre aléatoire (toujours finissable).

options.name: Room Difficulty
options.doc: Skill level used for the few rooms that Open World does not describe (rhelmot's requirements).
fr: Niveaux de rhelmot : quelles salles et quels passages les cartes mélangées peuvent utiliser. Plus haut = plus de salles possibles, des passages plus exigeants.

options.name: Room Coverage %
options.doc: Room shuffle: share of a chapter's rooms the generator tries to place before it keeps a layout. Higher = more rooms in each map (more variety, a little longer generation). Rooms that only have one usable opening (dead ends) can stay out whatever the value.
fr: Part des salles d'un chapitre que le générateur essaie de placer. Plus haut = plus de variété (génération un peu plus longue). Les culs-de-sac à une seule ouverture peuvent rester hors de la carte.

options.name: Dash Shuffle
options.doc: How dashing is shuffled. None: not shuffled. Unified: one `Dash` item gives the 8 directions. Cardinal Loose: 4 items; a direction also gives its two neighbouring diagonals. Cardinal Restrictive: 4 items; a diagonal needs both of its cardinal directions. Octal: one item per direction.
fr: Aucun : dash normal. Unifié : un objet Dash donne les 8 directions. Cardinal souple : 4 objets, chaque direction donne aussi ses diagonales voisines. Cardinal strict : 4 objets, une diagonale demande ses deux directions. Octal : un objet par direction.

options.name: Climb Shuffle
options.doc: How climbing is shuffled (forced to None with Developer Intended logic). Unified: one `Climb` item. Split: `Left Climb` and `Right Climb`.
fr: Aucun : normal. Unifié : un objet Climb. Séparé : grimper à gauche et à droite sont deux objets.

options.name: Crouch Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffle the ability to crouch.

options.name: Wall Jump Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffle the ability to wall jump (and wallbounce). Logic: every chapter except the Prologue requires Wall Jump. Forces Roomsanity on.
fr: Le saut contre un mur est un objet.

options.name: Demo Dash Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffle the Demo Dash (Celeste's "crouch dash": a dash that keeps Madeline's crouched 4 px hitbox, with the crouch-dash button or by holding down when dashing then aiming elsewhere). Until it is received, a dash that does not go downwards stands Madeline up. Logic (Vanilla Movement and Assist only): with Demo Dash + Left Dash + Left Climb (grab the step face, climb jump, demodash), the 3A Elevator Shaft dust wall (room 04-d) can be crossed ("shaftskip", frame-perfect), skipping the detour and the Presidential Suite Key. Off: demo dashes are free and the logic never expects the skip.
fr: Le dash accroupi (demodash) est un objet.

options.name: Interactable Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffle the interactable objects (Springs, Traffic Blocks, Feathers...): an object only exists once received. Off: every object is given at the start.
fr: Les 36 objets interactifs (ressorts, plumes, bulles, blocs...) sont absents tant que leur objet n'est pas reçu.

options.name: B-Sides
options.doc: Include the B-Sides.

options.name: C-Sides
options.doc: Include the C-Sides.

options.name: Core
options.doc: Include Chapter 8 - Core (and its B/C-Sides if those are included).

options.name: Farewell
options.doc: Include Chapter 9 - Farewell (one chapter, both halves).

options.name: Goal Area
options.doc: Chapter to clear (with the required Strawberries) to win. It is always included.
fr: Le chapitre à finir pour gagner. Il s'ouvre quand tu as reçu assez de fraises.

options.name: Total Strawberries
options.doc: Maximum number of Strawberries in the item pool.
fr: Nombre d'objets Fraise dans la partie.

options.name: Strawberries Required %
options.doc: Percentage of the existing Strawberries needed to win.
fr: Part des fraises qui ouvre le chapitre objectif.

options.name: Roomsanity
options.doc: Entering each room sends a check.
fr: Entrer dans une salle pour la première fois est un check.

options.name: Checkpointsanity
options.doc: Each checkpoint is an item ("Forsaken City A - Crossing"): it appears in the chapter select only once received (reaching it does not unlock it), and the logic knows that with it the chapter can be started from that room. Checkpoints are not checks: entering a room still sends that room's own checks. Off: checkpoints unlock by reaching them, as in the base game, and the logic always starts at the beginning.
fr: Chaque checkpoint est un objet : il débloque le départ depuis ce checkpoint.

options.name: Keysanity
options.doc: Keys are items ("Celestial Resort A - Front Door Key"), found anywhere in the multiworld. Owning one opens its door for good (every session, every start); picking a key up in a level sends that spot's check. Off: keys work as in the base game (picked up in the level, lost when a new session starts).
fr: Chaque clé de porte est un objet, trouvable dans n'importe quel monde ; l'endroit de la clé reste un check.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
fr: Quand un joueur meurt, les autres aussi.
